items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Duke had two basses for a while when he had Hayes Alvis and Billy Taylor.

ctx.x: Yeah, and Billy Taylor came in after him and Billy Taylor was really a good bass fiddle player for the band, you know. He made all those good records up until Blanton came. And, of course, Duke had two basses for a while when he had Hayes Alvis and Billy Taylor.
